text:
... guys.  FFS.  

The.  Stack.  Changed.  

Its not "60 series cards".  Its where the card sits in the stack.  

Used to be (roughly, with Ti/Super variants being a bit weird):

Titan
x80Ti
x80
x70
x60
x50

With the 20 series, the Titan went away, and the stack moved up.  

2080Ti
2080/SUPER
2070/SUPER
2060/SUPER
1660/Variants
1650/Variants

So, yes, the 2060 launched at 350.  Much higher than the 1060.  *because the product it was replacing on the stack was the 1070, not the 1060*

Its not fucking rocket science.  

You cant just pretend the naming scheme is what matters when, particularly depending on GPU manufacturer, it COMPLETELY CHANGES every generation or two.  

The 2060 was CHEAPER than the card it replaced in the stack (4th from the top).
